Synopsis:
    The US government holds a 35% stake via penny warrants in NABEP, a Venezuelan oil venture controlled by Alejandro Betancourt, granting anti-dilution protection and dividend rights ahead of warrant exercise. NABEP received 100-year rights to 17 Venezuelan oilfields (~65bn barrels). The Pentagon also holds a right of first offer on NABEP's output, with 20% purchasable at cost. Multiple additional deals (Chevron, Eni, ONGC, GeoPark, GE Vernova) aim to more than double Venezuelan output from ~1.1–1.2 mb/d over coming years. The arrangement draws scrutiny over Betancourt's background and Pentagon conflict-of-interest concerns around Cerberus-linked officials.
